known_limits: The session handshake transcript (SessionHello/Welcome/Final, domain AntiNAT-Session-v1) is a P08-owned additive wire element: the frozen contracts do not define session establishment (v0.8 §6.3 mandates a handshake whose final the Agent persists before socket activation). No frozen file was edited.

Result envelopes use message_type operation_complete (the frozen generic completion type) with deterministic message ids derived from the operation id, so reconnect re-envelopes the same operation/message id (v0.8 §6.1) and receivers dedup redelivery.

The controller sends C2A message_receipt as the durable receipt for agent results. The frozen protocol.md §3.6 direction column lists message_receipt as A2C; v0.8 §6.4 requires the receiving side to acknowledge and the sending side to GC only after a durable receipt, so the receipt must flow C2A for A2C results. Interpreted as the primary-direction column; documented for the spec reviewer.

controller_public_key bootstrap: the agent enroll client requires the pinned controller public key as an option (deployment profile). P05's config has no such field (config is P05-owned); P10/P18 must source it. The hub exposes ControllerPublicKey()/ControllerKeyID() for that wiring.
OnCommand is the P10 reconcile extension point: P08's default handler NACKs commands with no handler. desired persistence (SaveReceivedDesired) is wired by P10 via the same hook.

Windows DPAPI key files: FIX1 F2 removed the use-after-free; the Windows path remains cross-build evidence only (no native Windows runtime host in this milestone; the creator lock is a no-op there). The windows-tagged round-trip test compiles under GOOS=windows and runs on a Windows host.

FIX1 residual (pre-existing at base, out of F1 scope): if a command is journaled (ReceiveCommand) but not yet applied when the connection dies, the reconnect resend is swallowed by the agent's cached-duplicate path and no result is ever produced, leaking the controller row in SENT. Narrow race (us window between journal and apply); the shipped reconnect test now enqueues the second command only after the first apply so the disconnect cannot land inside that window. Recommend a lifecycle-cycle fix (distinguish journaled-not-applied from completed on resend).

FIX2 scope boundary: only a CACHED DUPLICATE receipt (same deterministic message id + type + payload already recorded in control_inbox) tolerates a failed row match. A genuinely unmatched receipt (fresh message id) still fails closed and kills the session, unchanged.
arm64 full-tree build still fails in P03's spike/sandbox (SYS_FORK/SYS_VFORK), pre-existing at the base SHA and unrelated to P08; all P08-owned packages cross-build for arm64.
Node IDs are store-form strings (<=16 bytes); the wire/transcript fields are the same bytes zero-padded to 16 (frozen transcript width). Node ids longer than 16 bytes are rejected.
P14 lifecycle owns the receipt-TTL sweeper for rows that stay SEMANTIC_ACKED after the requeue fix (the A2C-receipt-lost corner now retains the row by design instead of killing the session).
